synopsis: Jedi Academy: The Phantom Bully is the third book in the Jedi Academy Series: Adventures of Roan Novachez written by Jeffrey Brown Jedi Academy: The Phantom Bully sees the lead character of the series, the Padawan Roan Novachez, training under the Jedi Master Mr. Garfield.[4] The title also includes the resolution of the conflict that had been developed between the two characters in the first two installments of the series. It sees Roan working to try avoid the sorts of problems that plagued his sophomore year at the school. The book is intended the final installment in the series though a supplementary book, Jedi Academy: Attack of the Journal, was also made available.
title: Jedi Academy: The Phantom Bully
